rows.reason: A fixed grid choice (7.5-track, 270 nm height, 54 nm site) read from the PDK; it is a geometric constant, not a measured quantity.
A list of cells to be drawn; completeness is checked by counting cells against the list, not by a distribution.
One x1 drive per function; a choice of variants, with further drives stretch and not claimed.
RVT only, fixed by the layer markers used; no flavour comparison is made or claimed.
How the geometry is produced (scripted klayout.db, decision 0003); a method choice with no numeric outcome.
Per-cell and per-abutment DRC is a deterministic pass or fail from the pinned deck; the same input always gives the same verdict, so no sampling applies.
Per-cell LVS against its own CDL, fin count included, is a deterministic pass or fail from the extractor; no sampling applies.
GDS, LEF, CDL and structural Liberty are files whose presence and consistency are checked; timing Liberty is stretch and not claimed.
Corner definitions for any future characterization (TT target, FF and SS stretch); no characterization result is claimed, so no corner statistic exists.
An 8-bit counter flow through Yosys and OpenROAD, judged by tool pass or fail (synthesis, placement, routing, DRC); no timing figure is claimed.
